orderSource: LeetCode SQL 50 — 7 sections, 50 problems, free and judge-backed. Modules 01-06 follow it; 07-09 are deliberate off-spine extensions. Volume from HackerRank SQL (58); company realism from DataLemur/StrataScratch; Postgres-native and recursive from PGExercises. Full rationale and precedence rules: content/SOURCING.md.

tierRule.L1: Single concept, guided. Boundary = LeetCode SQL 50 Easy + HackerRank Basic Select/Aggregation.
tierRule.L2: Combinations and standard patterns, first EXPLAIN. Boundary = LeetCode SQL 50 Medium + HackerRank Basic/Advanced Join.
tierRule.L3: Optimization trade-offs, dialect differences, internals. Boundary = LeetCode SQL 50 Hard + Advanced SQL 50 + DataLemur Hard.
tierRule.L4: Constraint-driven techniques, plan forcing, partitioning. Predominantly synthesised — no free sheet reaches here.

levels.name: BEGINNER
levels.promise: Core syntax, mental models. Tables as grids. Every problem is solvable with one SELECT.

levels.name: INTERVIEW READY
levels.promise: Joins, grouping, windows. The standard pattern vocabulary an SQL screen actually tests.

levels.name: ADVANCED
levels.promise: CTEs, recursion, query optimization, dialect differences. You justify the plan, not just the output.

levels.name: EXPERT
levels.promise: Execution plans, partitioning, stored procs, triggers. Constraint-driven — mostly beyond any public sheet.
